verdict.rationale: Adyen for Platforms is fully API-driven (API-only onboarding, Legal Entity Management API, Configuration API) and provides webhooks to avoid polling plus test credentials for integration testing, all of which support automated/headless usage in scripts or CI pipelines. However, there is no explicit documentation of CI/CD integration, headless test automation tooling, or example pipelines. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD or automated-testing pipeline docs, sandbox/test-mode automation guidance, and any mention of running the platform's tooling in a CI context.
